name: Oda Nobunaga
source:
"I'll shoot you full of holes!"

Based on Oda Nobunaga, a powerful samurai daimyo and warlord of Japan in the late 16th century who initiated the unification of Japan near the end of the Warring States period. He lived a life of continuous military conquest, eventually conquering a third of Japan before his death in a 1582 coup.

Strong-willed, headstrong, ambitious. Nobunaga is the hero closest to unifying modern Zipang. She is rumored to be steadily preparing for unification by importing weapons from overseas. [url=/c5184]Himiko[/url], with her misplaced ambition for world domination, constantly attacks her, but Nobunaga brushes off these attacks in exasperation.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char01b]English official site[/url]]
